os/aiueos/scripts/verify-kotoba-kernel-o.reason: JUN-556: the object verifier accepts a comma-separated list of exports (at most 8) for multi-export objects from Amu: each name is exactly one GLOBAL FUNC in .text, there is one .rela.text entry per export (R_X86_64_PC32, addend -4, same local .data context symbol, inside .text). A single export keeps the original contract and output byte for byte. Refusals added: duplicate or empty names, more than eight, a missing name, a relocation count that does not equal the export count. No object produced by the pinned compiler changes. JUN-556 D1 (ADR 0380): an optional fourth argument names declared extern functions (at most 16); each is one undefined GLOBAL NOTYPE symbol, and every .rela.text entry after the per-export context relocations must be an R_X86_64_PLT32 addend -4 against a declared extern on a call rel32 followed by mov r9,[rbp-8]. Without the argument the contract and output are unchanged. JUN-556 D3/D3b/D4: .data may hold 8-byte cells after the 80-byte context (R_X86_64_PC32 against the context, addend 80 + 8k - 4, on mov rax,[rip+disp] / mov [rip+disp],rax with a zero displacement), an optional fifth argument declares GLOBAL OBJECT data symbols of size 8 at 80 + 8j, .data is exactly 80 + 8 * cells bytes of zeros, and every symbol must be null, the context, an export, a declared extern or a declared data symbol; fixed-address MMIO is an immediate in .text and adds nothing to check. JUN-556 fix: only GLOBAL/WEAK symbols are checked against the declared set, and the shim relocations may name either a LOCAL `context` symbol or the unnamed LOCAL .data section symbol older objects use; the previous check refused 115 of the 116 committed kotoba/*.o and broke the default build-uefi.sh. JUN-556 D6: a cell relocation may also sit on lea rax,[rip+disp] (the cell's address, handed to an extern). JUN-556 C (amu ADR 0385): optional .bss / .high_bss (NOBITS, WRITE|ALLOC, align 16, both or neither); a relocation into them is R_X86_64_PC32 against the LOCAL section symbol, inside the section, on lea rax,[rip+disp]. Output unchanged on all 118 committed objects.
